units.source_text: 让我坐在帘外，如此疏隔，教人好恨啊！”

en.t: To make me sit outside the curtain and keep me so distant like this, how hateful it is!"
Then he went closer to the threshold.

units.source_text: 众侍女互相扯衣推肘，悄悄地告道：“这个人鬼鬼祟祟的时候，丰姿也是很优雅的呢！”

en.t: The ladies in waiting tugged at one another's sleeves and nudged each other with their elbows, whispering, "Even when this man is acting so furtively, his bearing is still very elegant!"

units.source_text: 老夫人叫传言的侍女小少将君报以诗云：

en.t: The old lady had Lady Ko-shosho, the attendant who carried messages, reply with this poem:
